name: Gameplan T-Shirt
description: This is a t-shirt made from Soft Feels™ cotton, known for its breathability and soft feel. It features short sleeves and a raw-cut neckline for a casual, off-shoulder look. The t-shirt has a relaxed fit and an easy drape. The product page also displays it with checkered shorts, white ribbed socks, and athletic shoes.

name: Midwest Sweater
description: A navy blue, long-sleeved, crewneck sweater made from organic cotton. It features a relaxed fit with dropped shoulders and a thick ribbed knit texture throughout, offering comfortable, all-season wear. The Fine Rib stitch construction provides widthwise stretch.

name: Cozy Sweatfleece Zip Hoodie
description: A relaxed zip-up hoodie featuring a boxy, slightly cropped silhouette crafted from Cozy Sweatfleece with a soft brushed interior and sueded face. Designed for comfort with dropped shoulders and a double-layer hood, this midweight fleece offers a cloud-like feel and a casual, versatile look. Model shown wearing size S; available sizes include 2XS to XL with varying stock. Color and material specifics reflect Aritzia's Cozy Sweatfleece fabric.

name: Crew Longsleeve
description: A fitted, long-sleeve crewneck t-shirt made from a soft, breathable pima cotton with a second-skin feel and a smoothing effect. Perfect for everyday wear.

name: Heritage Knit Merino Wool V-neck Sweater
description: Cable‑knit, 100 % extra‑fine merino wool V‑neck sweater. The garment is fully fashioned, featuring a V‑neck and ribbed trim. Crafted with Aritzia’s responsibly sourced Merino Wool using the Anchor Cable stitch for a textured cable look inspired by traditional Irish heritage.

name: Middlebury Pant - Chino
description: Aritzia's Middlebury Pant in Chino is a low-rise, ultra-wide-leg pant crafted from lightweight stretch cotton twill, offering a relaxed yet refined fit. Features pleats at the front and belt loops for a tailored look. Designed for current style with seasonal versatility.

name: Lumi Sweatpant
description: French Terry mid‑rise joggers

name: Interstate Linen Balloon Pant
description: These low-rise balloon pants are crafted from 100% organic linen, offering a breathable and soft, airy feel with an authentic texture. They feature an oversized fit, inseam pockets, and a drawcord waist and hem for a relaxed silhouette.

name: Linen Pant
description: High-rise, super wide-leg linen pants made from 100% linen with a subtle texture and a soft, drapey feel. Features an elasticized drawstring waist for an adjustable fit. Perfect for travel or everyday wear.

name: The Effortless Pant™ Lo-Rise – Twill
description: These are low-rise, wide-leg trousers made from a soft, structured twill fabric. They feature front knife pleats and a relaxed yet tailored silhouette. The brushed-back twill offers an ultra-soft feel with a hint of stretch. The pants are designed with a lo-rise fit, embodying a modern and comfortable style.

name: Elba Linen Dress
description: Organic cotton tie‑front midi dress with cut‑outs and a thigh slit.

name: Original Contour Hour Dress
description: A second-skin V-neck mini dress featuring a deep neckline with intricate lace trim. Crafted from Aritzia's Original Contour fabric, this dress is designed with a double-layer construction for a supportive, body-shaping, and smoothing effect.

name: Original Contour Elevate Dress
description: Double‑layer mockneck micro dress with a second‑skin feel.

name: Elio Poplin Dress | Aritzia US
description: Cotton poplin babydoll bubble dress

name: Leiden Dress | Aritzia US
description: Japanese crepe midi squareneck dress

name: The Elowen Coat
description: The Elowen Coat is a sophisticated double-breasted belted coat crafted from a luxurious blend of Italian virgin wool and cashmere. Designed for warmth in temperatures as low as -10°C / 14°F, it features a relaxed fit, a removable belt, and an ultra-thin UnReal Suede Interlining for enhanced wind protection and insulation.

name: The Finch Mid Trench Coat
description: Water‑repellent cotton twill mid‑length trench coat with a classic fit

name: The Cocoon Coat - Luxe Wool Cashmere
description: Soft Italian virgin wool and cashmere coat with funnel neck

name: The Hemlock Trench Coat
description: The Hemlock Trench Coat is a meticulously crafted, double-breasted trench coat featuring a relaxed fit and a removable belt. Made from premium Italian City Twill, this water-repellent cotton twill fabric offers a smooth yet soft feel and provide warmth down to 0°C / 32°F. It's a classic, expertly tailored outerwear piece designed for versatility and style.

name: The Only Coat
description: Relaxed Italian soft wool-cashmere coat

name: Sperry X Aritzia Slim Jogger
description: These Sperry x Aritzia collaboration sneakers are a stylish and comfortable choice for everyday wear. Crafted with a premium suede upper in a rich brown hue, they feature a low-profile silhouette with a classic lace-up design. The removable insole provides added comfort and versatility, while interchangeable laces offer a customizable look. The non-marking outsole with signature Wave-Siping™ technology ensures excellent traction and stability. Blending heritage sport aesthetics with modern minimalism, these sneakers are perfect for elevating any outfit, from tailored trousers to denim and skirts.

name: G.h.bass X Aritzia Loafer
description: The G.H.BASS x Aritzia Milton Coin Penny Loafer is a contemporary reimagining of timeless preppy style. Designed for the fashion-forward woman, these loafers feature a distinctive square-toe silhouette and a premium Nappa leather upper with subtle gathered detailing. The design includes a signature penny keeper adorned with a co-branded coin for an elevated touch. For all-day comfort, they are equipped with a memory foam insole and a durable leather outsole. With a low 1-inch flat heel, these slip-on loafers blend structure, craft, and ease, making them suitable for both office and weekend wear.

name: Salomon XT-6
description: Lightweight, unisex trail running shoe designed for rugged terrain with a responsive ride and precise fit. Features Agile Chassis System and EndoFit for stability and comfort, a textile upper, and a durable rubber outsole suitable for trail surfaces.

name: G.h.bass X Aritzia Spence Loafer
description: The G.H.BASS x Aritzia Spence Coin Penny Loafer is a refined, feminine take on a classic Ivy League silhouette. Designed for the style-conscious woman, these brown suede loafers feature a rounded-toe shape, pleated outer vamp detailing, and a signature penny keeper adorned with a co-branded coin. For lasting all-day comfort, they are equipped with a memory foam insole and a flat 1-inch heel. The shoe is finished with a sleek leather outsole and leather lining, blending timeless heritage with contemporary confidence.

name: Women's G.H.BASS x Aritzia Milton Coin Penny Loafer
description: The Women's G.H.BASS x Aritzia Milton Coin Penny Loafer is a contemporary take on American preppy style. Crafted from premium Nappa leather, these brown loafers feature a modern square-toe silhouette with subtle gathered detailing on the outer vamp. The design includes a signature penny keeper accented with a co-branded coin for an elevated look. For comfort, they are equipped with a memory foam insole and a flat 1-inch leather heel, making them suitable for transition from the office to the weekend.

name: The Super Puff™ Mini Tote Bag
description: A unisex, adult-sized cliMATTE mini puffer tote bag featuring a water-repellent, wind-resistant ripstop fabric with a matte finish. The bag has a main zip closure and interior slip pocket, designed in a compact puffer style.

name: Wool Cashmere Lumen Hooded Scarf
description: The Wool Cashmere Lumen Hooded Scarf is a luxurious, hooded accessory designed for warmth and softness. It is knitted from a lofty, spongey yarn combining responsibly sourced wool and cashmere verified by The Good Cashmere Standard® by AbTF. This versatile piece features a hood for extra protection against the elements and a soft texture that feels gentle against the skin.

name: Tote Bag
description: A lightweight hi-gloss satin puffer tote bag designed for practical, everyday use. Made with water-repellent and wind-resistant Hi-Gloss taffeta from France, featuring a lightweight synthetic fill for insulation and structure. The bag is marketed as part of The Super Puff collection, suitable for carrying groceries and daily items, with a glossy finish and soft feel.

name: Zenith Silk Ribbon Scarf
description: A long, narrow ribbon scarf crafted from 100% silk with a luxurious, smooth feel and a subtle sheen. This piece features an in-house designed python pattern in muted brown and mauve tones, making it an elegant finishing touch for any outfit.

name: Loren Silk Large Scarf
description: A luxurious 100% silk charmeuse scarf featuring a custom-designed, intricate paisley pattern. This large scarf offers a rich texture and elegant drape, perfect for adding a touch of sophistication to any outfit. Sold out online.
